profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary: A Senior Software Engineer with 6 years of experience in the field. Knowledgeable and capable in front-end/back-end development and Dev Operations with a superb work ethic. Well-versed in a wide variety of computer languages/frameworks/tooling. Understands the complexity and the proper procedures around application/server/pipeline construction and maintenance. Is experienced in various methods of automating and optimizing work streams/deployments/code changes. Has invested hundreds of personal hours on AI technologies and AI models. Has a knack for communicating and providing a fun, efficient work environment. Proficient at learning new technologies, tools, and topics.
